value: Eighteen pre-fixed local pigmented isolates were identified (fraction 0.0501). The held-out cross-fitted reference gave count p=0.136 and fraction p=0.049 (Monte Carlo 95% interval 0.045-0.053); the same-fold sensitivity gave fraction p=0.048. A full-data joint spatial posterior-predictive check gave count p=0.222 and fraction p=0.123 (Monte Carlo 95% interval 0.121-0.125). Because the fraction did not show a robust upper-tail departure across predictive references, the isolates are retained as follow-up candidates rather than evidence of excess occurrence or horticultural provenance.
